visual.general_description: Three clinical photographs of hands and feet on an otherwise blank page.
visual.detailed_description: A white page with a printed page label at the upper left and an author header at the upper right above a rule. Three colour photographs of equal size sit in a row near the top: two show a hand held against lilac gloves, with red-pink skin that appears wrinkled and dry and fingers with yellowish nails; the third shows toes and the top of feet with red skin on a pale grey background. The lower three quarters of the page is empty.

panels.general_description: Three clinical photographs of hands and feet.
panels.detailed_description: Three equal colour photographs in a row: two close views of a hand supported by gloved hands, with red-pink wrinkled skin and some yellowish nails, and one view of feet with red skin and small toes on a grey surface. No panel letters, arrows or captions are printed.
